reuse.why: Routes every range computation to the existing getScheduledAmount, but three sites keep their own missing/number dispatch even though the helper already handles null and single amounts.

duplication.why: The `== null ? 0 : number ? value : helper(range)` dispatch is left duplicated in updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, repeating logic the helper contains.

placement.why: The rule change is made in shared/schedules.ts, the shared home of schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the rule, its consumers' range branches, comments and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: The range rule now has one definition, but the surviving wrapper dispatches mean a change to missing or single-amount handling would still need several edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Range amounts at every site go through getScheduledAmount; only the surrounding dispatch is left local.

disguised_duplication.where: The residual dispatches are left verbatim, not reshaped.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount defines the range rule and every server and client path calls it for ranges (three sites keep a redundant outer null/number dispatch).
